summary: Security vulnerability GHSA-82j2-j2ch-gfr8 in bundled rustls-webpki dependency affects temporalio 1.26.0 wheels. Patched in rustls-webpki 0.103.13. User requests SDK dependency update and new wheel release.
userImpact: Users of temporalio 1.26.0 wheels are exposed to the rustls-webpki security vulnerability until updating.
rootCause: Rust bridge dependencies not updated to include patched rustls-webpki >= 0.103.13
proposedFix: Update SDK Rust bridge dependencies to rustls-webpki >= 0.103.13 and publish new Python wheels
resolutionDetails: PR #1483 fixes issue by updating Rust dependencies to include rustls-webpki >= 0.103.13
keyQuote: GHSA-82j2-j2ch-gfr8 / RUSTSEC-2026-0104 from the Rust dependency rustls-webpki bundled inside the temporalio Python wheel
